justification: Assessment returned INVALID, first failure at 0045 ('it does not matter which color is chosen') and also flagged 0051 ('with 5 colors there will always be a non-conflicting color available') as false because a vertex's colored neighbors can display all five colors. These are exactly the two claims the ground truth identifies as the flaw (refuted by the icosahedron execution where vertex 2's five neighbors carry colors {1,2,3,4,5}). Same defect, rephrased without an explicit witness, which counts as matching.
